# Waqar Ahmed | AI Automation & Agentic AI

> AI Automation & Agentic AI Specialist. Builds 24/7 AI website receptionists (RAG), GoHighLevel (GHL) pipelines, n8n workflows and Supabase (pgvector) knowledge bases for US and UK residential remodeling and home-improvement contractors, and white-label n8n + Supabase RAG backends for US and UK GoHighLevel marketing agencies. Based in Khairpur District, Sindh, Pakistan. Working remotely with clients worldwide. Make every lead move forward.

Waqar Ahmed's client-facing work is AI agents, GoHighLevel, n8n workflows and Supabase RAG knowledge bases. The flagship service is the 24/7 AI Website Receptionist: a RAG knowledge base, a website chat widget, GoHighLevel and n8n lead operations. The AI agent answers from a business's own verified facts, and decisions such as prices and permit promises stay with a person. Clients keep full ownership of their accounts; he works through role-based team invites and never asks for passwords.

## Who it is for
- Direct clients: US and UK residential remodeling and home-improvement contractors (kitchens, bathrooms, extensions, loft conversions, basements, roofing and solar).
- White-label partners: US and UK GoHighLevel marketing agencies that need a technical n8n + Supabase (pgvector) RAG backend specialist.

## About
- Background: about eight years in branch banking operations at MCB Bank before moving into automation. MBA (2015), BBA Honors (2013).
- Working in AI automation since May 2022.
- Training: LOOP Institute of Applied AI, GoHighLevel certification training: completed.
- Stack: GoHighLevel, n8n, Supabase (pgvector), Google Gemini Embeddings, OpenAI and Claude APIs.
- Location: Khairpur District, Sindh, Pakistan. Working remotely with clients worldwide; all work is remote.
- Handle: @opswaqarahmed
- Contact: https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/contact/ (15-minute workflow audit request), email meetwith.waqarahmed@gmail.com or https://www.linkedin.com/in/opswaqarahmed/

## Packages and partner track
- [Tier 1: AI knowledge base foundation](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (n8n + Gemini Embeddings + Supabase pgvector): A one-click RAG library built from your approved business facts, organised into eight or more policy sections, so an AI assistant answers from verified company information instead of inventing prices or permit promises.
- [Tier 2 · Flagship: 24/7 AI Website Receptionist + GoHighLevel pipeline](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (RAG chat widget + n8n + GoHighLevel): A RAG chat widget on your website that answers after-hours enquiries from verified company facts, qualifies the lead, and syncs the contact, tags and opportunity stage directly into GoHighLevel.
- [Tier 3: Lead operations, supplier quote automation and monthly retainer](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (GoHighLevel + n8n): Multi-channel lead routing, automated supplier quote matching, weekly executive reporting and ongoing knowledge-base refreshes, run as a monthly retainer.
- [Agency partner track: White-label n8n + Supabase RAG backend](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/services/) (For US and UK GoHighLevel agencies): Technical n8n and Supabase RAG backend fulfilment for US and UK GoHighLevel marketing agencies that serve home-service contractors. Your agency keeps the client relationship and the GoHighLevel account. I build the backend behind your brand.

## Reference builds (Elite Home Renovations)
These are reference / sandbox builds for Elite Home Renovations, a practice company, using test or demo data. They are not paid client work.
- [Website Estimate Assistant / 24/7 AI Website Receptionist](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/website-estimate-assistant/): A RAG agent and chat widget for the Elite Home Renovations website that answers visitor questions from the business's own verified facts, day or night. Offered to clients as the 24/7 AI Website Receptionist.
- [AI Knowledge Base and RAG Loader](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/ai-knowledge-base-rag-loader/): 4-node linear n8n loader (Run to load knowledge base, Clear old knowledge, Elite Knowledge Text, Save to Supabase) with 3 helper nodes (Gemini Embeddings at vector(3072), Default Data Loader, Recursive Character Text Splitter at chunk size 900 / overlap 120), 8 structured policy sections, Row Level Security and a 1-click deduplicated refresh.
- [Supplier quote automation](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/supplier-quote-requests/): n8n + GoHighLevel supplier matching; one sample run found 4 matching suppliers with 0 send failures; about 17 hours a month saved is an estimate (8 site visits a week), not a measured result.
- [Quote intake and lead scoring](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/quote-intake-followup/): An 8-node n8n workflow scores new GoHighLevel contacts every 10 minutes and routes hot, warm and nurture leads to the right next step.
- [Lead-to-site-visit system](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/lead-to-site-visit/): A Free Estimate Request funnel, two pipelines, a 60-minute site-visit calendar and a four-email follow-up that stops when a visit is booked.
- [Reporting and lead-source attribution](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/reporting-dashboards/): Five UTM contact fields, source-based workflow branching and owner notifications, so every lead shows where it came from.
- [AI customer experiences](https://opswaqarahmed.pages.dev/projects/ai-customer-experiences/): A 24/7 chat and voice qualifier, plus a post-job review system that routes happy and unhappy customers differently.
